test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Find the time taken by a boat to travel 80 km with the current, if the speed of the boat in still water is 14 km/h and the speed of the current is 6 km/h.
solution:
Given:

Speed of a boat in still water = 14 km/h

Distance covered = 80 km 

Speed of the current = 6 km/h

Formulas used:

Speed downstream = Speed of boat + Speed of stream 

Time = Distance/Speed 

Calculation:

Downstream speed = 14 + 6 = 20 km/h

Let the time taken be = t 

80 km/(20) = t

⇒ 4 = t

⇒ t = 4 h

∴ The Time taken by boat to travel 80 km downstream is 4 hours.
